annotations.title: Log a data subject request (Betroffenenanfrage, Art. 15–22 GDPR)

description: Logs a data subject request (access, erasure, rectification, restriction, portability, objection) in the connected frag.hugo account and calculates the one-month deadline of Art. 12(3) GDPR. Step 1 (without `bestaetigung`): preview with the deadline, the possible extension, a note on identity verification and a reply draft from the frag.hugo templates, plus a confirmation value valid for 15 minutes. Step 2 (same input plus `bestaetigung`): creates the request; the data protection officer on file is notified. It does not send anything to the requesting person. Use only for requests addressed to the user’s own organisation.

art.description: Type of request: access (Art. 15), erasure (17), rectification (16), restriction (18), portability (20), objection (21)

beschreibung.description: What the person asks for, in short

bestaetigung.description: Value from the preview. Omit it to get the preview; send it unchanged to log the request.

eingegangen_am.description: Date the request was received (YYYY-MM-DD). Starts the one-month deadline. Not in the future.

kontakt.description: E-mail address or postal address for the reply

name.description: Name of the requesting person as given in the request

sprache.description: Output language. Default: German if the input is German, otherwise English.

name: create_data_subject_request

frist.description: Deadline for the answer (YYYY-MM-DD), one month from receipt
